postBaselineImageObservations.observation: All four external terminals, +/−/~, six central contact circles, two closely spaced horizontal central switch strokes, lamp circle/X, capacitor plates and connecting wires are retained. Caption and neighboring prose are outside the crop. Lower contact circles attach separately to left return and right lamp branch; central switching strokes are kept as printed, not assigned an inferred switching state.

Capacitor plates, C, top/bottom wires, both right terminals and the entire voltage expression are retained. A small interruption in the lower-left wire is already in original pixels, not a crop omission. Amplitude subscript remains visually m/M-shaped; script identity is not established.

Axes, arrowheads, vertical quantity labels, t, both solid curves, both crossings, both leader arrows, and origin glyph are retained. Printed i_c(t) points to the thicker curve rising to the earlier crest; u_c(t) points to the thinner curve rising to the later crest. The round inclined origin glyph does not uniquely establish O versus 0. No label swap or scientific erratum.

Equation 2.26 shows the inclined multi-stem amplitude subscript, compatible with Cyrillic м or italic Latin M. Equation 2.27 has a closed oval subscript, visibly unlike equation 2.28's open c. Letter o versus digit 0 is not established; whether closure is printed o/0 or damage to c also cannot be established. Candidate X_o is provisional shape transcription only, not an approved identity.
